stories.title: Ao PITV 1, Joel Rodrigues promete cortar secretarias e contratar 5 mil policiais

en.title: On PITV 1, Joel Rodrigues promises to cut secretariats and hire 5,000 police officers
en.summary: Piauí gubernatorial candidate Joel Rodrigues pledged to reduce the number of state secretariats and gradually hire up to 5,000 security professionals if elected.

stories.title: Rinoplastia em 2026: por que o conceito de "nariz da moda" ficou no passado

en.title: Rhinoplasty in 2026: why the concept of "trendy nose" became a thing of the past
en.summary: Rhinoplasty has evolved to prioritize preserving individual facial identity rather than following uniform aesthetic standards, reflecting a broader trend in cosmetic surgery toward natural results.

stories.title: Candidatos ao governo da Paraíba são entrevistados no JPB1

en.title: Candidates for governor of Paraíba are interviewed on JPB1
en.summary: Three candidates for Paraíba's governorship will be interviewed between Monday and Wednesday on JPB1, broadcast on TV Cabo Branco, Paraíba, Globoplay and G1.

stories.title: Donos de creche para cães em Botafogo são indiciados por maus-tratos após denúncia de ex-funcionário

en.title: Owners of dog daycare in Botafogo are indicted for animal cruelty following former employee's report
en.summary: Owners of a dog daycare in Botafogo were indicted by Rio's Civil Police for animal cruelty after videos from a former employee documented assaults and inadequate confinement conditions.

stories.title: Passageira denuncia motorista de aplicativo por cobrar taxa extra para entrar em condomínio na zona Leste de Porto Velho: 'Ninguém quer entrar lá'

en.title: Passenger reports app driver for charging extra fee to enter condominium in East Porto Velho: 'Nobody wants to go in there'
en.summary: A passenger reported an app-based driver for charging an additional fee to pick her up from a condominium in Porto Velho. The driver allegedly demanded extra payment and threatened to remove her, her 12-year-old sister, and 2-month-old daughter from the vehicle.

stories.title: STF suspende sessão que analisa relatório da PF sobre relação entre Moraes e Vorcaro; ministros voltam às 14h

en.title: Supreme Court suspends session analyzing Federal Police report on Moraes and Vorcaro relationship; ministers return at 2 p.m.
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court suspended a historic session where justices were evaluating whether to investigate colleague Minister Alexandre de Moraes based on a Federal Police report documenting messages between him and a former banker.

stories.title: Resende recebe profissionais e empresários para encontro sobre reforma tributária e IA nesta quarta-feira

en.title: Resende hosts professionals and entrepreneurs for meeting on tax reform and AI on Wednesday
en.summary: Resende, Rio de Janeiro will host a business meeting on Wednesday featuring three short lectures by specialists on tax reform and artificial intelligence, aimed at small and medium business owners facing strategic decisions.

stories.title: Dino cita vídeo de Fábio Porchat e música de Chico César em julgamento do STF sobre Moraes

en.title: Dino cites Fábio Porchat video and Chico César song in Supreme Court judgment on Moraes
en.summary: During a Supreme Court hearing evaluating Minister Alexandre de Moraes' conduct, Justice Flávio Dino referenced a comedian's video and a musician's song while discussing revealed messages between Moraes and a former banker.

stories.title: Dino cita vídeo de humor de Porchat e compara ministros a jornalistas por reviravoltas no caso Master

en.title: Dino cites Porchat humor video and compares ministers to journalists over twists in Master case
en.summary: During a Supreme Court session reviewing a report on the connection between Justice Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, former Banco Master owner, Justice Flávio Dino referenced a viral humorous video by Fabio Porchat.

stories.title: Caixa e bancários retomam negociações nesta quarta (16), mas greve segue sem prazo para terminar

en.title: Caixa and bank workers resume negotiations Wednesday (16), but strike continues with no end date
en.summary: Caixa Econômica Federal and bank workers' representatives resume talks aimed at ending a nationwide strike that began on the 10th, which remains ongoing with no specified end date.

stories.title: Kassio e Toffoli se declaram suspeitos e não votarão em sessão sobre Moraes no STF

en.title: Kassio and Toffoli declare themselves biased and will not vote in session on Moraes at Supreme Court
en.summary: Supreme Court justices Kassio Nunes Marques and Dias Toffoli declared themselves biased and will not participate in voting during an unprecedented session on a Federal Police report regarding messages between Daniel Vorcaro and Alexandre de Moraes.

stories.title: Mendonça diz que encaminhou autos sobre Moraes e Vorcaro a Fachin por iniciativa própria

en.title: Mendonça says he forwarded Moraes and Vorcaro case to Fachin on his own initiative
en.summary: Justice André Mendonça denied that the court's presidency initiated the transfer of the case file concerning alleged messages between Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro.

stories.title: Leitura de relatório e bate-boca entre ministros: como foi a primeira etapa da sessão do STF para julgar Moraes

en.title: Report reading and arguments between ministers: how the first stage of the STF session to judge Moraes unfolded
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Federal Court began analyzing a Federal Police report containing messages from former banker Daniel Vorcaro to Justice Alexandre de Moraes. The session opened with document reading and was marked by heated disputes among justices over allegations of political conduct.

stories.title: Senac completa 80 anos apontando para o desenvolvimento do Brasil

en.title: Senac completes 80 years pointing toward Brazil's development
en.summary: The Senac institution marks 80 years of contributing to Brazil's social and economic development. Founded in 1946, it operates as part of an internationally recognized system combining business administration with worker welfare and qualification initiatives.

stories.title: Moraes e Mendonça sobem o tom; ministro pede julgamento conjunto e ameaça chamar testemunhas

en.title: Moraes and Mendonça escalate tensions; minister requests joint trial and threatens to call witnesses
en.summary: Justice Alexandre de Moraes demanded his trial be held jointly with Justice André Mendonça's on the same date, citing common factual and evidentiary bases. The exchange between the justices grew contentious during proceedings at Brazil's Supreme Court.

stories.title: Em meio a bate-boca, Dino questiona Fachin e Gilmar aponta abuso em decisão contra a PF

en.title: Amid arguments, Dino questions Fachin and Gilmar points to abuse in decision against the PF
en.summary: Confrontation escalated at the Supreme Federal Court session when Justice Flávio Dino directly challenged President Edson Fachin's conduct, sparking widespread exchanges of criticism among justices in the plenary.

stories.title: Grass promete revisar renúncia fiscal de empresas no DF e aumentar arrecadação sem elevar impostos

en.title: Grass promises to review tax waivers for companies in DF and increase revenue without raising taxes
en.summary: A PT candidate for governor of Brazil's Federal District pledged to reassess tax exemptions granted to large companies, aiming to balance the budget without increasing tax rates. He stated the review would examine whether each waiver complies with law and generates proportional benefits for the population.
